_note: Web copies of the print catalogue's booklet photos (the 34 PNGs in _archive/design-assets/catalog-print-build/assets/booklet). The plain "<booklet file>": "<web url>" entries are read by catalog-print-build/src/generate_plugin.py and must stay strings. "_photos" (2 Oct 2026) says, per web file, what the frame shows, the system and place a record states, and where the site uses it. A place or project name is only ever quoted from the record named in "record"; "confidence" is that record's. Copies from 2 Oct 2026 are JPEG q82, longest side 1600; the 2026 copies are 1800px q85.
